## Remove burned-in video captions with UnMarkAI

### How it works

Prepare authorized videos for caption replacement, localization, or product-copy updates. This manual workflow imports a directly downloadable public HTTPS video, waits for upload completion, creates one UnMarkAI text-removal job, polls its status, and returns a temporary download link. Choose one selected region, up to three non-overlapping regions, or full-frame removal.

### Setup

Import the template and open Configure Video. Set the source URL, actual dimensions, and removal coordinates in original-video pixels. The supplied 12-second, 1280 × 720 tutorial settings belong only to that source.

Create your own Header Auth credential: header Name is Authorization; Value is Bearer YOUR_API_KEY, replacing the placeholder with your key. Select it on all four HTTP Request nodes. The key needs jobs:read and jobs:write.

Keep execute_paid_job=false for a preview without API requests. Check current API rates and balance, choose a unique request_key for the exact video and settings, then enable paid processing deliberately.

The template is free; API processing is separately billed, with no dollar spending cap. Stopping local polling does not cancel remote processing or prevent billing. Download results promptly and inspect the entire clip for artifacts.

This UnMarkAI-affiliated template uses built-in n8n nodes. A live API flow passed; its output was not visually reviewed.

## 1. Configure and preview

Set your video, source dimensions, and removal region. Select your own Header Auth credential on all four HTTP nodes. Keep execute_paid_job=false to preview; check rates and balance before enabling separately billed processing.

[API setup guide](https://unmarkai.net/video-text-removal-api/) · [API reference](https://unmarkai.net/dashboard/api/docs/)

## 2. Preview or import

Preview Only makes no API requests. A paid run imports the URL, then polls until uploaded before creating a job. If import fails or waiting stops, inspect the existing upload before retrying.

## 3. Create once; recover safely

Use a unique request_key for this exact video/settings. POST requests use separate idempotency keys; automatic retries are off. After ambiguous errors, preserve the original body and upload ID. The documented idempotency window is 24 hours.

## 4. Review, download, and credit

Stopping polling does not cancel processing or prevent billing. Download temporary results promptly; review the whole clip. The [published example](https://unmarkai.net/examples/remove-text-from-video/tutorial-captions/) is separate from the unreviewed test output.
